description: One ID photo spec: print size in mm, head size and how it is measured, allowed backgrounds and whether the background may be changed, online pixel size and file limit where there is one, who takes the photo, the official source and the date it was checked, and a link to make the photo in the browser. Always pass on the notes; they say what the photo must not be used for.

locale.description: Language of the linked page. Default en.
